siblings.result: Works end to end on an anvil mainnet fork after a real --broadcast: live hydration, cutoverStartBlock round-trip and eth_getLogs all behaved, and it passed with 29/29 users. It fails correctly on a regranted V1 mint and on a late CUTOVER_START_BLOCK. It inherits the story-085 floor unchanged, so a staker self-exit between the initiateMigration and migrate txs makes it revert with a false 'below floor' loss alarm on a correct cutover. Its own comment (L45-46) excludes self-exits from the per-user check but not from the floor.

The spot-reproduced test_fork_v2Paused_verifierReverts passes. Coverage gaps: (a) no self-exit scenario; (b) _forkAndCutover calls cut.run() in PREVIEW, whose smoke test leaves a 1000-DOLA organic stake in V2 (_probeAutoAnnihilate never withdraws), so test_fork_cleanCompletedState_verifierPasses exercises the DOLA aggregate floor with up to 1000 DOLA of masking; (c) hydration is overridden, a gap now closed by this run's anvil exercise. These are observations, not findings.

siblings.result: It probes the breaker at phase0, after-phase1 and after-phase8 only, so it cannot see the Phase-7 register(V2)-before-unpause window. This run's per-transaction probe shows EnforcedPause for 3 txs.
Unchanged. The divergence from mainnet (no Phase-1 retire, no floor, no verifier, 2-wei slack) is the Q-01/Q-03 class, which the owner ruled invalid (UI mock). Not re-filed.
Holds at 25981150: Pauser has 26 registrants, the phase0 simulated pause SUCCEEDED, and the post-finalize sweep passed with 27.
5/5 aggregateFloor tests pass. There is no V1 userMigrate self-exit case, which is the scenario NEW-02 needs.
No interaction with the 084/085/086 delta was found.

operational.topic: OWNER ETH budget vs the pinned 0.3 gwei legacy price
operational.result: The anvil rehearsal used 18,317,077 gas over 46 txs. OWNER holds 0.005642 ETH and would be left with 0.000147 ETH. At 0.31 gwei or more, the node rejects tx #37 (USDe migrate) for insufficient funds (gasLimit*price > balance), and the run halts mid-Phase 6. The run is resumable after a top-up.
